sources.excerpt: Japan won the tournament for the fourth time after defeating Fiji 20–15 in the Grand Final. Semi-finals were held in Ōsaka on 12 September, followed by the third-place play-off and final in Tokyo on 19 September.

The Senate of Bolivia ratifies an agreement to take a US$1.9 billion loan from the International Monetary Fund amid a deep economic crisis in the country, with trade unions threatening renewed protests in response.

Researchers have named a newly identified snake species from New Guinea Lielaphis slashi, or Slash's groundsnake. Her opportunity eventually came in the form of a reddish-brown snake measuring 28 inches long that had been collected in the forests of New Guinea.
